# Numbeo

> > The world's largest crowdsourced database of cost of living, quality of life, and economic data for cities and countries worldwide.

Numbeo provides up-to-date price comparisons across categories including restaurants, groceries, transportation, utilities, and housing. The platform aggregates user-contributed data to help individuals, researchers, and businesses compare living expenses globally.

## Key Topics

- Cost of Living
- Price Comparison
- Crowdsourced Data
- Quality of Life
- Housing Prices
- Restaurant Costs
- Grocery Prices
- Economic Data
- Living Expenses
- Global Database
- Transportation Costs
- Utility Prices
- City Comparisons
- Country Statistics

## Overview

- [Cost of Living](https://eclasszone.inpt.numbeo.com/): Homepage for Numbeo's cost of living database with global city comparisons

## Country Cost of Living Data

- [Cost of Living in Pakistan. Prices in Pakistan. Updated Mar 2026](https://baikal.wikide.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/country_result.jsp?country=Pakistan): Pakistan cost of living data: restaurants, food, transport, utilities
- [Cost of Living in Cyprus. Prices in Cyprus. Updated Mar 2026](https://ctmsltd.sles.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/country_result.jsp?country=Cyprus): Cyprus cost of living data: restaurants, food, transport, utilities
- [Cost of Living in Nigeria. Prices in Nigeria. Updated Mar 2026](https://baikal.wikiit.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/country_result.jsp?country=Nigeria): Nigeria cost of living data: restaurants, food, transport, utilities
